name: Volvo Car AB (publ.)
summary: Volvo Car AB (publ.) is an automotive company primarily engaged in the design, development, manufacturing, marketing, assembly, and sale of passenger vehicles. Its operations span global markets, including significant presences in Europe, China, and the United States. The company's product portfolio encompasses sedans and sport utility vehicles (SUVs) marketed under its flagship Volvo brand. Additionally, Volvo Car offers electric automobiles through both the Volvo marque and its distinct Polestar brand. Complementing its vehicle sales, it also provides vehicle components and accessories, alongside a robust online retail channel. Established in 1927 and headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden, Volvo Car AB (publ.) functions as a subsidiary of Geely Sweden Holdings AB.
